why: DISCLAIMER-1: the words that say the product is not an official Microsoft product and that Microsoft does not support it. They are written once, here. The report and the install read this file. The dashboard pages carry a copy in help.js and the manual has the full notice on its Disclaimer page; tests/unit/Disclaimer.Tests.ps1 holds both copies to this file, and this file to the agreed words. Change them only with the agreement of the owner.

fields.shortLine: The short line: at the foot of every dashboard page, and in every report and download.
fields.title: The title of the full notice.
fields.paragraphs: The full notice, one paragraph each: at the first sign-in in a browser, on the manual page and in the install.
